title: Database Access in Server Applications
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of database access in server applications using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates database access in server applications.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Database Access in Server Applications** as part of **Kotlin for Backend and Server-Side Development**. A server endpoint should validate input, apply authorization at the server boundary, return consistent status codes, and be covered by tests and operational monitoring. Use the subtopics—Connecting to a Database, Repository and Service Layers, Transactions and Migrations—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Backend code handles untrusted requests and persistent data. Validation, authorization, predictable errors, and operational checks must happen on the server.

items.title: Connecting to a Database
items.text: Connecting to a Database crosses a system boundary. Model success and failure, validate external data, apply timeout/retry rules deliberately, and keep credentials and database access out of presentation code.

items.text: Repository and Service Layers is part of reproducible project configuration. Declare the dependency or plugin where it belongs, preserve a compatible version set, and use the Gradle Wrapper for repeatable builds.
